title: Energetic register gallery
logline: litt in the energetic register (docs/decisions/0007): a terminal that types, a collage formula on a grid, an annotation over an organic subject, and a reel that closes its own loop. Reference + lint fixture.

scenes.intent: The reel opens on a terminal that types its question — linear, mechanical, the machine speaking.
scenes.motion: Card snaps in on the steep ease, the command types, the answer types after it. Then the camera flies forward.

scenes.intent: The collage formula: archive image, code, a data card, then the brand sticker slaps on top.
scenes.motion: Pieces land on the pop spring, staggered 2 frames apart, from up to 128px. The sticker slaps last. Hold ~1s.

scenes.intent: Organic subject, technical overlay: a tree ring gets numbered markers joined by hairlines.
scenes.motion: The image drifts inside its frame; markers pop in, hairlines draw between them on the steep ease, caption wipes on. Then fly back out.

scenes.intent: The loop closes: back on the terminal, which types the handle.
scenes.motion: The same terminal as the open; the handle types, the caret blinks, hold.
